label: D2: a1 led commonly to S1, right after an unrewarded rare (or unseen) trial, early in the episode
explanation: Active only at D2 (100% of mass), and only when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 (common transition). It also needs the D1 reward input to have been 0 (prev_reward == 0, 99.7% of mass). Nearly all of the remaining mass falls where the previous transition was rare or is unknown (first trial of the window): the agent stayed on a1 after a rare-unrewarded trial (the MB stay case) and the common transition then confirmed it. It fires mostly in the first ~55 trials of an episode and never after trial ~65, so it depends on slow drift across the episode. Activations go with high value (value > 8.1 holds 93% of mass) and a positive a1 choice logit. All variables are observed by D2. Dev: P 0.71, R 0.91, F1 0.80, mass recall 0.98. Never fires at D1/GO, after a2 or S2, after a rewarded previous trial, or late in the episode. False positives are cases of the same pattern that stay below threshold; the longer history does not separate them cleanly. Magnitude was not fully characterised beyond its link with value.
